# Numbeo City Prices, Indices and Rankings Scraper

Numbeo publishes crowd-sourced prices and liveability indices for thousands of cities and countries. This actor turns those pages into structured JSON: itemized prices with low/high ranges, quality-of-life and safety indices, commute details, property metrics, two-city comparisons, country profiles, food/restaurant/gas/grocery prices, and historical or current rankings. It reads public pages without cookies, logins or API keys.

## What it does

- Scrapes every core Numbeo section: cost of living, quality of life, crime, health care, pollution, traffic, and property prices.
- Adds country profiles (national-average prices plus the ranked city table) and four market-price pages: food, restaurant menus, gasoline/vehicles, and groceries.
- Resolves city names through Numbeo's own city-search endpoint, so `New York`, `New York, NY`, `São Paulo` and pasted city URLs all reach the right page.
- Supports two-city comparisons with the site's own summary sentences and the equivalent-amount calculation.
- Returns all ranking families for cities, countries, regions, or the current rolling edition, with editions back to 2009.
- Converts prices to any of Numbeo's supported currencies and switches between metric and US units.
- Includes contributor counts, data-point counts and last-update dates when the page publishes them.
- Omits empty fields at every depth; no nulls, blank strings or placeholder values.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `costOfLiving` | Page family: `costOfLiving`, `costOfLivingComparison`, `qualityOfLife`, `crime`, `healthCare`, `pollution`, `traffic`, `propertyInvestment`, `topCities`, `country`, `foodPrices`, `restaurantPrices`, `gasPrices`, `groceryPrices` or `byUrl`. |
| `city` | string | – | City name or Numbeo city URL for city and market modes (the form pre-fills `New York`). |
| `cities` | array | `[]` | Additional cities to scrape in the same run. |
| `country` | string | `""` | Country name for `country`, `foodPrices`, `restaurantPrices`, `gasPrices` and `groceryPrices` modes. |
| `countries` | array | `[]` | Additional countries for the same modes. |
| `countrySections` | array | `["costOfLiving"]` | Sections to scrape in `country` mode: cost of living, quality of life, crime, health care, pollution, traffic, property. |
| `country1` | string | – | Country hint for city 1 in comparison mode (the form pre-fills `United States`). |
| `city1` | string | – | City 1 in comparison mode. |
| `country2` | string | – | Country hint for city 2 in comparison mode (the form pre-fills `Germany`). |
| `city2` | string | – | City 2 in comparison mode. |
| `rankingType` | string | `costOfLiving` | Ranking family: cost of living, quality of life, crime, health care, pollution, traffic or property. |
| `rankingScope` | string | `cities` | `cities`, `countries`, `region` or `current`. |
| `rankingPeriod` | string | `""` | Historical edition such as `2024`, `2024-mid` or `2009`; empty means the latest edition. |
| `region` | string | `world` | Region for `rankingScope=region`: `world`, `africa`, `northern-america`, `south-america`, `asia`, `europe` or `oceania`. |
| `urls` | array | `[]` | Direct Numbeo URLs; each is routed to the matching parser in `byUrl` mode. |
| `displayCurrency` | string | `""` | ISO currency code for every price; empty keeps local currencies. |
| `measurementSystem` | string | `metric` | `metric` or `US` units. |
| `maxItems` | integer | `5` | Maximum records to emit (1–1000). Raise it for full ranking tables. |
| `useProxy` | boolean | `false` | Route requests through Apify Proxy. |
| `autoEscalateOnBlock` | boolean | `true` | Retry through Apify Proxy after a direct rate-limit or challenge. |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | `{"useApifyProxy": true, "apifyProxyGroups": []}` | Proxy settings used when `useProxy` is on or escalation triggers. |

Examples:

```json
{"mode": "costOfLiving", "city": "Berlin", "displayCurrency": "EUR", "maxItems": 1}
```

```json
{"mode": "costOfLivingComparison", "city1": "New York, NY", "country1": "United States", "city2": "Berlin", "country2": "Germany"}
```

```json
{"mode": "topCities", "rankingType": "propertyInvestment", "rankingScope": "countries", "rankingPeriod": "2024", "maxItems": 100}
```

```json
{"mode": "country", "country": "Germany", "countrySections": ["costOfLiving", "qualityOfLife", "crime"], "displayCurrency": "EUR"}
```

```json
{"mode": "byUrl", "urls": ["https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Tokyo", "https://www.numbeo.com/quality-of-life/rankings.jsp?title=2024"]}
```

## Output

Every record carries `recordType`, `siteName`, `scrapedAt` and `sourceUrl`. City and country records add `pageTitle`, `title`, `country`, `city`/`cityLabel`, `cityId` when resolved, `currency`, `displayCurrency`, `measurementSystem`, `contributors`, `dataPoints`, `lastUpdate` and `nearbyCities` when the page provides them.

- **Cost of living:** `prices` (`item`, `category`, `price`, `currency`, `priceCurrency`, `rangeLow`, `rangeHigh`), `summary` (family-of-four and single-person monthly costs in local and display currency, comparison city and percent), `categoryTotals`.
- **Quality of life:** `qualityOfLifeIndex`, `qualityOfLifeIndexRating`, `indices`, `indexDetails`, `components` (label, value, rating label), `contributorsMin`, `contributorsMax`.
- **Crime, health care, pollution:** `indices`, `indexDetails`, `sections` (each with `title` and `rows` of label/value/rating), `whoPollutionData` and `whoPollutionDetails` for pollution.
- **Traffic:** `indices`, `indexDetails`, `transportModes` (mode share), `averageCommute`, `commuteByMode`, `co2EmissionsKgPerYear`, `treesToOffsetCo2`.
- **Property:** `indices`, `indexDetails`, `rents` (rent and buy-price rows with category), `countryStatistics` (GDP per capita, GDP growth, population growth).
- **Comparison:** `comparison` rows with primary and alternate-currency prices per city plus `differencePercent`; `comparisonSummary`; specific difference fields; `standardOfLiving` equivalent amounts; `city1Label`, `city2Label`.
- **Rankings:** `rank`, `city` or `country`, the index fields for that ranking type, `rankingType`, `rankingScope`, `rankingPeriod`, `region` when applicable.
- **Country profiles:** the same price/index/section fields with `countrySection`, plus `cityRankings` for that country.
- **Market pages:** `prices` for food, gas and grocery pages; `menuItems` (with category) and `cityRankings` for restaurant pages.
- **Errors:** `recordType: "error"`, `errorKind`, `message`, and the attempted `url`/`city`/`country`.

## Notes and limits

- Numbeo rate-limits bursts from one IP (HTTP 429). The actor paces requests and retries with backoff; `autoEscalateOnBlock` can continue through Apify Proxy.
- Rankings are complete server-rendered tables, typically 300–600 cities or 90–150 countries. There is no pagination; `maxItems` is the only cap.
- Numbeo's city-search endpoint returns a short suggestion list. The actor picks the best exact match and accepts a country hint for ambiguous names.
- The premium “Prices by City” and “Prices by Country” tables require a paid Numbeo plan and are not scraped.
- Single-city pages show current data only; historical coverage is available through rankings.
- Data is crowd-sourced and changes as contributors update it. Each run reflects the pages at fetch time.

## FAQ

**Is this an official Numbeo API?**
No. It is an independent reader of Numbeo's public pages, not affiliated with Numbeo.

**Do I need a proxy or cookies?**
No cookies or login are used. Numbeo is usually reachable directly; proxy escalation is optional and automatic.

**Why are some ranges missing?**
Numbeo shows a low/high range only when enough contributions exist for that item. The field is omitted when the page does not show it.

**How do I get every ranking row?**
Set `maxItems` above the table size (for example `1000`). The daily test uses `1` to stay cheap.

**Can I scrape more than two cities in a comparison?**
Numbeo's comparison page is two cities only. Use `cities` with a city mode to compare many places from the resulting records.
